landing.title: Stream widgets for OBS
landing.headline: Stream widgets that don't eat your CPU
landing.description: Chat, alerts, goals, scene screens and a drawing board you can hand to a friend. Pick a style, tweak the animation, paste one link into OBS.

hints.hideAfter: 0 keeps messages until new ones push them out.
hints.ignoredUsers: Bots and users whose messages are hidden. Press Enter after each name.
hints.text: Leave empty for the default. Tokens: {'{name}'} {'{count}'} {'{months}'} {'{tier}'} {'{amount}'}. Plural: {'{count|sub|subs}'}.
hints.textResub: Used when months is greater than 1. Leave empty for the default.
hints.min: Smaller amounts don't trigger an alert.
hints.minMessages: Same emote in this many different messages.
hints.countdownTo: Local time. Leave empty to hide the countdown.
hints.title: Leave empty for the default text for the selected mode.
hints.sceneBackground: 3D looks great but uses the GPU. Pick a lighter background if your game stutters.
hints.perMessage: For rain, rise and fly. Explosions and fountains use “Emotes per explosion”.
hints.commandPrefix: Votes look like prefix + number, e.g. !1. Leave empty to accept plain numbers.
hints.allowChange: Otherwise only the first vote counts.
hints.autoClose: Counted from Start. 0 = until you press Stop.
hints.command: Also works: command+ command- command set 10 command reset
hints.cooldown: Ignores the command when used again too quickly.
hints.keyword: Viewers type exactly this in chat to join.
hints.firstMode: Twitch marks real first messages. Kick has no such flag, so it always uses the first message in this session.
hints.spotlightCommand: e.g. !msg Hello everyone. Leave empty to turn it off.
hints.startMinutes: Used on Reset. Press Start in Actions to begin the countdown.
hints.tierMultiplier: Tier 2 adds twice as much, Tier 3 three times.
hints.startValue: Progress you already had before this stream.
hints.lines: Press Enter after each text. Empty = default welcome text.
hints.clockMode: Uptime is read from Twitch or Kick every minute.
hints.triggers: Pick what starts the effect. Chat uses the emotes from the message.
hints.scaleWithAmount: More gifted subs, bits or raiders = more emotes (up to 10×).
hints.alertEmotes: Emote names from your channel, e.g. KEKW. Empty = random emotes from your 7TV/BTTV/FFZ set.
hints.spread: How far emotes fly from the center of an explosion.
hints.rewards: Exact reward titles. Press Enter after each one.
hints.goalSource: “Channel total” uses real follower and sub counts from Twitch (login required) and Kick followers. Bits and gifts always count this stream.
hints.endHold: How long the final level stays after the train ends.
hints.combine: Adds Twitch and Kick viewers into one number.
hints.alertImage: Shown above the text in the “Image on top” layout (Style tab).
hints.alertLayout: “Image on top” shows the image of each alert type with the text below it.
hints.minAmount: Smaller donations are skipped. 0 shows every donation.
hints.secondsPerDonationUnit: Seconds added for each 1 PLN, 1 EUR or 1 USD donated.
hints.variantsSub: A different look for longer subs or higher tiers. The tier with the highest minimum that matches wins; empty fields use the defaults above.
hints.variantsDonation: For example one alert from 5 zł and a bigger one from 50 zł. The highest matching tier wins; empty fields use the defaults above.
hints.variantsBits: A different look from a given number of bits.
hints.variantsGifts: A different look from a given number of gifted subs.
hints.variantsRaid: A different look from a given number of raiders.
hints.ttsEnabled: Plays after the alert sound, never on top of it. The alert stays on screen until reading ends.
hints.ttsMinAmount: Donations below this amount show up but are not read.
hints.ttsSource: Tipply sends its own recording with each donation. StreamElements and Streamlabs do not, so Piper reads those.
hints.blockSlurs: A built-in list of racist, homophobic and similar slurs in all five languages, including spaced-out and l33t spellings.
hints.bannedWords: Press Enter after each word. End a word with * to also catch longer forms (e.g. idiot* catches idiots). Case, Polish letters and l33t are ignored.
hints.musicSource: Spotify sends songs to Last.fm on its own (Spotify settings → Social → Last.fm). For SoundCloud, YouTube Music, Deezer, Tidal, Bandcamp or Apple Music on the web install the free Web Scrobbler extension and connect it to Last.fm or ListenBrainz.
hints.musicUser: Your Last.fm or ListenBrainz username. Your recent listening must be public.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What this app stores about you, why it needs it, and how you get rid of it.

sections.title: Who runs this
body: Streaming is a small tool for making stream widgets, run by the owner of this site.
If anything here is unclear, ask through the project repository.

sections.title: Data you give us
body: Starting as a guest stores a random user id and the channel nicknames you typed. Nothing else.

Signing in with Twitch or Kick also stores your account id, login, display name, avatar URL and access tokens. Tokens are encrypted before they reach the database and are only used to read your own channel data: followers, subscriptions, viewer count, channel point rewards, polls and hype trains.

If you connect a donation service (StreamElements, Tipply, Streamlabs), its token or widget link is stored encrypted and used only by the server to receive your donations. Donor names, amounts and messages are passed to your overlays and not stored; donor e-mails are discarded.

sections.title: Widget data
body: Widget settings, saved styles, uploaded sounds, images and videos and the content of a drawing board are stored on the server so your overlays keep working after a restart.
Some state stays in your browser only: counters, timers and the last pinned message, so an OBS refresh does not reset them.

sections.title: What happens in the browser source
body: Widgets connect from your browser or from OBS straight to Twitch, Kick, 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ to read chat and emotes. Those services see the IP address of that machine and handle it under their own privacy policies.
Fonts come from Google Fonts. There are no analytics, no ads and no tracking scripts anywhere in the app.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Data stays until you delete it. Deleting a widget removes its settings and its links. Deleting a file in the Library removes it from the server and from every widget that used it. Guest accounts (a nickname only, no Twitch or Kick sign-in) are deleted with all their widgets 48 hours after they were created.
Images and videos uploaded on a drawing board are deleted from the server automatically once they are no longer on the board.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can see, change and delete everything from the dashboard. Disconnecting a linked account also removes its tokens.
Deleting the account in the dashboard removes everything at once: widgets and their links, styles, uploaded files, drawing boards and connected accounts. It happens immediately and cannot be undone.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: A free tool for streamers. Use it, break it, tell us what broke.

sections.title: What you get
body: Access to the widgets in the app, one OBS link per widget and storage for your settings and files.
The service is provided as is. Features may change, and there is no promise that it is always online or bug free.

sections.title: What you upload
body: You are responsible for the sounds, images, videos and text you put into widgets. Do not upload anything you have no right to use, and nothing illegal or harmful.
Files that break these rules or put the server at risk can be removed.

sections.title: Links you share
body: An overlay link shows your widget to anyone who opens it, and a drawing link lets anyone who has it draw on your stream. You decide who gets them.
Generating a new link in the editor immediately kills the old one.

sections.title: Other platforms
body: Twitch, Kick and the emote providers have their own rules; using this app does not change them, and your accounts there stay yours.

sections.title: Liability
body: The app is not liable for damage caused by using it, including anything that ends up on your stream. You are the one who decides what goes on screen.

sections.title: Changes
body: These terms can change as the app grows. Anything important will be visible in the app.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: Only the cookies the app needs to work. No tracking, no ads.

sections.title: What is stored
body: Session cookie: keeps you signed in, or keeps your guest session alive. Without it the app cannot save anything.
Language cookie: remembers the language you picked.
Theme cookie: remembers light or dark mode.

sections.title: Local storage
body: Widgets keep small pieces of state in your browser: a counter value, a running timer, the last pinned message. It never leaves your computer and it is what makes an OBS refresh harmless.
The cookie notice you dismissed is remembered there too.

sections.title: Turning them off
body: You can clear or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block them, signing in and saving widgets stop working.

sections.title: Third parties
body: Emotes, badges and fonts are loaded from Twitch, Kick, 7TV, BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ and Google Fonts. Those services may set their own cookies in the browser source.

cookieBanner.text: This site only uses cookies it needs to work: your session, language and theme. No tracking, no ads.
